description: Insurance Board of Sri Lanka - The Loss Adjuster Registration Rules - 2017, made by the Insurance Board of the Sri Lanka
reasoning: This gazette content contains rules made by the Insurance Board of Sri Lanka under the Regulation of Insurance Industry Act, No. 43 of 2000. It establishes regulatory requirements, qualifications, and registration procedures for loss adjusters in the insurance industry. This falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it involves statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
